title: Monthly books close
goal: Close the month {month} for venture {venture} from connector data only: revenue, refunds, fees, payouts, ad spend, model spend; nothing estimated.

steps.title: Gather the figures and write the close
steps.brief: For {month}: read stripe.charges, stripe.refunds, stripe.payouts (sinceDays covering the month) and, if a Park Store or Notice board is in your zone, shopify.orders / etsy.receipts and meta_ads.insights / google_ads.metrics. Write outbox/books/close-{month}-{venture}.md: revenue (paid charges or paid orders, say which source), refunds, Stripe fees (only if the charges carry them), payouts, ad spend, and a line "model spend: see the Peak's results table" (you cannot read it here). Every figure cites its source and its count of rows; a figure no connector holds is written as "no data", never 0 and never estimated. End with the three largest items of the month.
